summary: Interview the user about recurring work and maintain implementable workflow specifications in a stateful workspace.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.change: Replace impossible completeness with decision completeness
deltas.reason: Require consequential decisions to be settled while leaving ordinary implementation choices open.
deltas.tradeoff: The implementer may still ask a legitimate new question.

deltas.change: Ground the interview in actual runs
deltas.reason: Use ordinary and awkward examples to reveal missing behavior efficiently.
deltas.tradeoff: Adds a short simulation rather than relying entirely on conversation.

deltas.reason: Delay human interruption through authorized preparation, but stop before the action requiring that judgment.
deltas.tradeoff: Some workflows retain an earlier checkpoint than maximum automation would prefer.

deltas.reason: Keep proposals, settled decisions, and abandoned workflow history legible.
deltas.tradeoff: Slightly more file stewardship than unrestricted create-edit-delete.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.
